rationale: S-0074-03 proposes an AIS-localised Kv7 follow-up tagged as a t0075 candidate. The follow-up is already planned and committed as `t0075_bio_realistic_ais_param_sweep` (status `not_started`), which attaches a bio-realistic AIS+axon to Bed A with {HHst, Nav1.6, Kv3, Kv7}, calibrates a baseline, and runs an 8-axis one-at-a-time sensitivity sweep covering AIS-localised Kv7. The suggestion is operationally fulfilled by the existing planned task. Rejecting as covered.
